row.body: The cabinet key is attached to a delivery slip marked complete before the kitchen passed inspection. The installer’s meal receipt is still unpaid.
row.title: Cabinet delivery before clearance

sidecar.gloss: A kitchen delivery is completed before inspection.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field kitchen could receive cabinets before a safety check; the slip does not show who cleared the room.

row.body: the hole punch and clipboard smell sharply of bleach. mud outlines between them show that a third object was removed.
row.title: missing count beside the hole punch

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
